content: Postgres-as-queue is the right call at modest scale (1K-10K jobs/sec ceiling). Patterns: status-column + SELECT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED for atomic claim; pgmq (Supabase Queues) gives SQS-like API with visibility timeouts if you want it prebuilt. For tiny pipelines a plain status/stage enum column advanced by each cron stage is simplest and observable; SKIP LOCKED only matters with concurrent workers. Cross-checked dbpro, richyen/Microsoft, aminediro.
